snippet.title: Aphelion | Reveal Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Aphelion is a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure game developed and published by DON’T NOD. 

Coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Game Pass in 2026. 

Wishlist today on Xbox.

About the game:  

By 2060, Earth will be uninhabitable. The discovery of a 9th planet – Persephone – at the edge of the Solar System, is humanity's best hope. The European Space Agency is dispatching the Hope 01 scientific mission, consisting of 2 accomplished astronauts, Ariane and Thomas. Their mission: to survey the planet and determine whether humanity can prosper anew here. 

Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This story-rich sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay. 

#AphelionGame, #DontNod, #XboxShowcase, #scifigaming 

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
